verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe Copilot connectors for OneDrive, Outlook.com (email/calendar/contacts), Google Drive, and Gmail/Calendar/Contacts, with concrete example queries for finding files, emails, and calendar events (copilot-docs-7/13/19/25/26/27/40/43). Community comment confirms cross-document data fetching works well (copilot-comm-7), while another clarifies this connector feature is scoped to the standalone Copilot app rather than Office-integrated Copilot (copilot-comm-1), a scope caveat rather than a failure. Missing for 10: deeper independent hands-on verification specifically of the connector search/answer flow (most community feedback concerns Office in-app editing, not the connector-search feature) and clarity on rollout/availability limits.
